title: Tracking
limitReached: All slots are in use. Pause a task or change your plan.
schedule: Checks every {hours} hours; up to {max} under load. Telegram may delay checks.
error: Could not load tracking. Please try again.
retention: Duration: {months} month(s). Messages are kept until completion and for {days} more days.
name: Tracking name
matchHelp: A word or phrase with at least {min} characters.
userHelp: The sender's numeric ID, not an @username.
groupsOnePerLine: Enter each group or channel on a new line, not separated by spaces.
noJoin: One username, link or chat ID per line. The service does not join chats.
botHelp: For Telegram alerts, link the bot and enable notifications in its settings.
empty: No tracking yet. Add a group and choose what to look for.
select: Select a tracking task to view its messages.
overdue: The check is delayed. Another attempt is scheduled.
confirmStop: Finish permanently? Collection will stop and retained data will be deleted after the retention period. To continue later, use Pause instead.

reasons.manual: Paused manually. The expiry date is unchanged. After resuming, only new messages are collected.
reasons.subscription_expired: Paid access ended. Resume manually within your current plan limit.
reasons.plan_limit: Paused because the current plan allows fewer active tasks.

errors.busy: Collection is busy. We will retry automatically.
errors.flood_wait: Telegram temporarily limited requests. We will retry automatically.
errors.session_unavailable: The Telegram connection is unavailable. Contact support.
errors.group_unavailable: The group or channel is no longer accessible.
errors.collection_failed: Could not load messages. We will retry automatically.
errors.search_incomplete: Search did not finish. We will retry automatically.
errors.pagination_stalled: Collection was interrupted. We will retry automatically.
